comment: The response security posture as reviewed policy. tools/check-security-headers.mjs EVALUATES apps/web/lib/security-headers.ts (node --experimental-strip-types, no bundler, no node_modules) and diffs the values it actually returns against this file. Values, not text: a gate that greps a source file for directive names is satisfied by a directive that appears in a comment. Widening anything here is a CODEOWNERS-reviewed act — the file is git-clean-enforced by check-gate-integrity.mjs, so the change appears in the PR diff.

hstsPreload.reason: Two years with includeSubDomains and preload. Recorded because it is close to irreversible: removal from the browser preload list takes months, so a consumer serving any subdomain over plain HTTP must change this BEFORE first deploy, not after.

coep.reason: Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy ships UNSET. require-corp breaks every third-party embed and image that does not send its own CORP header, and the failure mode is a silently blank subresource. A gate that produces a broken app is a gate everyone exempts. Revisit when the app needs crossOriginIsolated (SharedArrayBuffer, precise timers) — nothing in the seed does.

styleSrcUnsafeInline.reason: Next injects critical CSS as inline <style> with no nonce hook, so this is structural rather than chosen. Materially smaller than the script-src equivalent: CSS injection cannot execute, and selector-based exfiltration is bounded by connect-src and img-src.
